question_put_to_a_human: What are chapters 775 through 784 about, in one sentence? Put to a human before this file was written, as it has been put before every writer since 595. No human has answered it for any block from 595 onward. No writer answers it for them. It is recorded here unanswered and it stays open until somebody answers it.
family: THE FAMILY FOR THIS BLOCK IS DECLARED BEFORE ANY CHAPTER EXISTS AND IT IS A WRITER'S, NOT A HUMAN'S. THE FAMILY IS A REPAIR THAT WORKS. Somebody finds something wrong in their own place and means to deal with it their own way. Somebody else arrives, takes the second half, and does it properly. BOTH METHODS ARE SOUND, NEITHER OF THEM IS THE VISITOR'S FAULT, AND NEITHER OF THEM IS WHY THE PLACE IS WORSE AFTERWARDS. The fault in every chapter is not in a method at all. It is in the position, the choice, or the moment: a repair put where the place cannot take one, a repair that takes something out and puts nothing back, a repair that puts something in where nothing was, a repair measured by the thing before it and not by the thing after it. Every chapter ends with a thing that is better and a place that is worse, and nobody in any of the ten can say which of the two was the job. Ten chapters, five standing figures, the man off the ring road sitting out for the third block running because no second job on a different room for a different reason is on the page, and in every chapter one job, one better way, and one fault that is in neither method.
family_why_this_and_not_the_last_two: In 755 to 764 the adopted method was right for the job and had a hole in it, and the fault was in the method and the host took it on and kept it. In 775 to 784 the adopted method has no hole in it and it is still wrong, because the method was never the question. THE FAULT IS IN THE REPAIR ITSELF. A later writer may not go back to a fault in a method in either direction, that is, neither the visitor's method being wrong (0057) nor the adopted method having a hole in it (0058). Tested against all eighteen spent families, 595-604 through 765-774, and the testing is set out in the prompt and repeated in this file under family_tested_against_every_spent_family.

cards.0775: At number nine a woman in her late fifties has a coal hole lid warped and standing open and means to plane it flat and get it shut; the woman who does her shopping makes a new lid out of a length of board and fits it, and it shuts, and that hole was the only thing letting air through that side of the house and the wood standing in it was dried by it.
cards.0776: At the lock-up a woman in her late forties has the roller door's edge cutting a dip into the bay floor where it has been dropping since the summer and means to knock the dip out and screed it level; the woman who books work lays a sheet of ply over the dip on a batten and screws it down, and the ply now takes the cut that was cutting the concrete, and it will be cut through in a winter.
cards.0777: At number ten a woman in her early thirties has a boundary board leaning out of plumb and means to knock a wedge under it and pack the hole; her sister puts a raking strut and four turns of wire on it, and the whole run cannot now be taken apart to get at anything behind it without cutting the wire.
cards.0778: At the unit a man in his early forties has a length of pipe hanging out of the middle of a wall where nothing was ever put through it; he means to cut it off short and cap it, and the woman from two doors down pushes it back into the wall, packs the hole out and clips it, and the wall now has a pipe in it that goes nowhere and whoever opens that wall will find it.
cards.0779: At number twelve a woman of seventy-eight has one paving stone rocking in the side passage and means to lift it and relay it on sand; her sister takes the whole bay up and relays it on a thicker bed, and the bay stands a hand's width proud of the passage and everything that used to run across it now stops at it.
cards.0780: At number nine a woman in her late fifties has a worn hollow in the middle of the back step where the door has been catching and means to fill it with mortar; the woman who does her shopping lays the offcut of her own old stone step over the hollow, and the door shuts a hand's width lower at that point than it does anywhere else on the door.
cards.0781: At the lock-up a woman in her late forties has the top edge of the ramp crumbled where the front end of the trolley has been chopping at it and means to knock the crumbled bit off and screed it; the woman who books work lays the old kerbstone that has been standing in that yard across the top of the ramp, and the ramp has a step on it, and everything that comes up it comes up in two goes.
cards.0782: At number ten a woman in her early thirties has a gap in the boundary hedge about the width of a barrow and means to open it up properly so the barrow will go through it; her sister closes the gap with three lengths of dead hedge and four stakes, and the barrow does not go through and has not gone through since.
cards.0783: At the unit a man in his early forties has the bottom of the store door gone soft and means to cover it with a sheet of hardboard; the woman from two doors down fits a new bottom rail of a different thickness, and the door shuts on the rail and there is now a gap at the top of it.
cards.0784: At number twelve a woman of seventy-eight has the wooden kerb of her flower bed come away from the wall so the bed floods, and means to put a brick on the kerb and hold it down; her sister lets a new length in and beds it in cement, and the bed is a raised bed now and the wall behind it is taking everything that comes off it.

movement: Ten jobs, ten good methods, ten faults that are in the repair and not in either method. 0775 a new lid on a coal hole shuts the only air path on that side of the house. 0776 a sheet of ply on a batten over a dip in a bay floor takes the cut that was cutting the concrete. 0777 a raking strut and four turns of wire make a leaning run of boarding that cannot be opened without cutting the wire. 0778 a pipe pushed back into a wall and packed is now inside the wall for ever. 0779 a whole bay of the side passage relaid on a thicker bed stands proud and stops everything that used to cross it. 0780 the offcut of an old stone step over a hollow in the back step puts the door out of line with itself. 0781 an old kerbstone across the top of a ramp makes a step on a ramp. 0782 three lengths of dead hedge and four stakes close a gap that was wanted open and the barrow has not gone through since. 0783 a new bottom rail of a different thickness shuts the door and opens a gap at the top of it. 0784 a new kerb bedded in cement makes a raised bed and puts the whole wall's water into it. Every job is dry work and every job is done from the ground.
door_meetings: Nobody is kept at a boundary in this block and the second person is at work inside a minute of arriving. 0775 the woman who does her shopping at the FRONT DOOR of nine with the bags, in through the front door and straight round to the coal hole at the side. 0776 the woman who books work in the bay of the lock-up, standing in the dip with the roller door up over her. 0777 the sister at the far end of the boundary run at ten, already there when the host comes out into the lane. 0778 the woman from two doors down through the gate of the unit at the middle of the morning. 0779 the sister at the FRONT DOOR of twelve in the morning, and they go through the house and out by the yard door to the side passage. 0780 the woman who does her shopping at the BACK DOOR of nine with no bags, which is the other door and not the standing arrival at the front. 0781 the woman who books work through the lane gate of the lock-up at the end of the morning, out at the ramp where the work is, not in the bay. 0782 the sister through the gate of ten in the morning, and out into the yard with her. 0783 the woman from two doors down, and HE GOES AND GETS HER, which is the only chapter of the ten where the visitor does not come to him. 0784 the sister through the yard gate of twelve with a length of board under her arm. THE SAME TWO PEOPLE ARE AT THE SAME DOOR IN THE SAME MANNER IN NO TWO CHAPTERS: the woman who does her shopping is at the front door with bags in 0775 and at the back door without in 0780; the woman who books work is in the bay in 0776 and at the ramp through the lane gate in 0781; the sister at ten is at the far end of the run in 0777 and through the gate in 0782; the woman from two doors down comes through the gate in 0778 and is fetched in 0783; the sister at twelve is at the front door in 0779 and through the yard gate in 0784.
closing_images: Ten different ones, and NOT ONE OF THEM IS A THING LEFT WHERE IT IS AND NOT ONE IS A THING PUT AWAY, on the narrow reading settled by the read-back of 0058, where a thing left where it is means an object that was to be moved, worked on or taken away and was not, and a fault the adopted method made in the course of the chapter and nobody undid is not one. 0775 a hand flat on a shut lid and the whole of the air gone out of one side of a house. 0776 a shaving lifted out of the groove in the ply with a torch lying on it. 0777 a claw hammer on wire that will not move. 0778 two people knocking on a wall and the hollow answer out of it. 0779 grit lying in a line along the foot of a bay that stands proud of a passage. 0780 the back of a hand along the bottom edge of a door finding where it goes down. 0781 a sack going up a ramp in two goes. 0782 a barrow stopped dead by three lengths of dead hedge. 0783 a line of daylight along the head of a store door. 0784 the face of a wall going dark from the foot up behind a good new kerb. The fault in every one of the ten is a fault in the repair and not an object left standing, so none of the ten spends either of the two narrow endings. THE DEPART-AND-DO-NOT-FOLLOW GESTURE IS IN 0776 AND 0781 ONLY. A departure out of a gate is in 0775, 0779, 0782 and 0784. Four different closings of a scene: the visitor gone before the discovery in 0776, 0777 and 0788's neighbour 0783, the visitor still there at the end in 0780 and 0781, and the visitor and the host side by side in 0778, 0779, 0782 and 0784.

still_live_and_taken_up_by_nobody_here: Four pallets with the blocks in the middle of every one of them wet through. Three boards down a muddy path and a hole digging itself out at a shed corner. Four feet of bare frost wall at twelve. A coal hole with a green furry middle in it. A gate post wired at the top and the bottom and leaning in between. A trolley with its back legs in the air on a ramp. A scaffold board standing proud of a shed door under a beech. A sheet of kitchen floor with its uncut edge across a doorway. A gate that shuts behind two wedges and stands open in front of them. A cowl on an air brick and a damp patch coming up the wall behind it. NONE OF THESE IS A MYSTERY, NONE OF THEM IS GOING TO BE ONE, AND NONE OF THEM KNOWS ABOUT ANY OF THE OTHERS. Off the page and waiting on the man off the ring road, who has now sat out three blocks: a figure for four rooms given aloud twice in a lock-up and written nowhere; a frame out of square which its own man will find at the fitting; a landing wall with a bare patch on it and a mirror in a van; a fourth room at the top of a stair that nobody has priced or looked into. Three lines of paper shut in a drawer on purpose with the tools that would do them. A box in a corner of a lock-up whose lid is not nailed.

Three chapters mixed something wet in the first draft and two of them were made dry in the repair: 0778 packs the hole out with a hardwood offcut and a bead of sealant, and 0781 beds the kerbstone on sand and bolts it down with two flat bars. One remains, and it is card-mandated: the card for 0784 says the sister beds the new kerb in cement. The chapter says so and it says plainly that the cement is mixed in the yard by the coal shed and not through the tap in the kitchen. That is recorded for a human and is not settled here.

read_back.readers: a second reader over the whole committed block with the eight canon chapters 0755, 0756, 0758, 0760, 0761, 0762, 0763 and 0764 and the sixteen points, arithmetic and facts first and prose last, run inside the writing pass; and a separate mechanical pass over the ten files for the sweep, the measures, the standing objects and the continuity against 0770, 0767, 0768 and 0773.
read_back.no_card_moved: No card, no date, no family, no band, no standing object and no planned turn was changed, and no chapter was restarted.
read_back.THE_BIG_ONE: THE SECOND STANDING-STATE INVENTORY OF EVERY HOUSE REPEATED THE FIRST ALMOST WORD FOR WORD. Measured on the body, the ten chapters shared 267 ten-token spans across pairs of chapters, and most of them were the two lock-up chapters, the two unit chapters, the two chapters at ten and the two chapters at twelve standing in front of each other. All five pairs were rewritten in the second occurrence, being 0780, 0781, 0782, 0783 and 0784. The block now measures 0 cross-chapter spans and 0 intra-chapter spans. The same fault was recorded against 0058 in the review of that block and this block repeated it, and that is on the record rather than argued away. A NEXT WRITER SHOULD MEASURE THIS FIRST AND BEFORE ANY WORD OF PROSE IS WRITTEN, BECAUSE IT IS CHEAP AND BECAUSE THE TWO HOUSES THAT SHARE AN INVENTORY ARE ALWAYS THE SAME TWO IN A ROTATION OF FIVE.
read_back.inside_one_chapter: 0781 argued the screed-and-key point in almost the same words three times and it is now argued once and referred to twice. Four small repeats in 0775, 0777, 0778 and 0780 were rewritten.
read_back.closed_clock_times: 0784 had half past nine, 0782 had at nine, 0779 had at about nine, 0781 had about eleven and 0780 had about ten. All five are cut and the arrivals are now placed inside the day rather than on the clock.
read_back.two_wet_jobs: 0778 mixed and wetted a bag of mortar and 0781 mixed a strong mix in a bucket. Both are now dry work: a hardwood offcut and a bead of sealant in 0778, a sand bed and two bolted flat bars in 0781. The cement in 0784 stays because the card for 0784 names it, and it is flagged.
read_back.continuity_conflict: 0781 had the trolley coming up the ramp on all four casters and dropping onto its back casters over the kerbstone. Chapter 0770 has the front caster smaller than the one that came off, so the frame rides low at the front and the back legs are already in the air before the top of the ramp. 0781 now has the back legs hanging at about a yard from the top, exactly as they hung in 0770, and the kerbstone stops the trolley a yard further down than it used to stop, which is also worse and is the point.
read_back.banned_words_written_and_cut: hold, holds, held, holding, changing, changed, threshold, noticed, panel and others were written in the first draft and are at zero on the files now. The card for 0777 said a boundary PANEL and the prose calls it boarding, close boarding and the run, because panel is on the banned sweep at zero.
read_back.ring_and_collar: 0778 had a ring of old mortar round the packed hole and a ring round the pipe, which is the wrong noun for a wall at the unit and sits a word away from the ring on the tiles at twelve. It is a collar now.
read_back.draft_surplus: 0780 carried a drafting artefact into the file, a sentence about watching her sister and then no, and it is cut.
read_back.water_bowl_sweep: The bowl on its shelf and the ring on the tiles at twelve are not in any of the ten. No washing line is named at twelve in either of its chapters and no line at all is mentioned there.
read_back.the_coal_hole_wood: 0775 does not look into the coal hole, does not count the load and does not carry anything out of it. The fault is reasoned out from a shut lid and the outside air, so the green in the middle found in 0768 is not re-found and is not resolved.

card_disagreements_settled_to_the_prose.0777: The card said a boundary PANEL. The banned sweep carries panel at zero, so the prose says a run of close boarding, a length of boarding, a board and the run. The card's meaning is untouched.
card_disagreements_settled_to_the_prose.0781: The card said the ramp's top edge is crumbled where the front end of the trolley has been chopping at it. The prose agrees with the card and also says, once, that the trolley's back legs have hung in the air since November, because 0770 put them there. The prose wins over the card where the card is silent.
card_disagreements_settled_to_the_prose.0775: The card says the wood in the coal hole was dried by the hole. 0768 says the front rows were dry and the middle went green with the lid shut. The prose reconciles them rather than choosing: the front was dried by the air through the hole and the middle was not, and shutting the hole takes the air away entirely.
card_disagreements_settled_to_the_prose.0784: The card says the bed floods and that the new kerb is bedded in cement. Both stand, and the cement is the one wet job in the ten.
card_disagreements_settled_to_the_prose.0783: The card says there is now a gap at the top of the door. The prose gives the mechanism: a leaf hung for years with its top edge hard against the head, made effectively taller by a thicker bottom rail, rides that much higher on three hinges with play in them, and daylight runs the whole width of the head.
card_disagreements_settled_to_the_prose.0780: The card says the door shuts a hand's width lower at that point than anywhere else on the door. The prose makes the offcut thicker at the hinge end than at the latch end, which is true of a step that stood forty years with its edge out, and gives the mechanism of a door stopped higher at one end than at the other having to swing further closed.

settled_by_this_block.the_fault_is_in_the_repair: Ten chapters, ten adopted methods with no hole in them, and ten faults that are in the repair itself. A later writer may not go back to a fault in a method in either direction.
settled_by_this_block.no_narrow_ending_spent: Not one of the ten closes on a thing put away and not one on a thing left where it is, on the narrow reading settled by the read-back of 0058. All ten close on a fault the adopted method made in the course of the chapter and nobody undid, which the same reading puts outside both categories.
